selector.rationale: Histopathological examination showing dense diffuse infiltrate of lymphocytes, histiocytes, epithelioid cells, giant cells, plasma cells, eosinophils, and neutrophils with intracellular yeasts and special stains highlighting fungal forms supports Histoplasmosis

rejected.label: Chronic granulomatous disease
rejected.why: Lack of specific evidence for chronic granulomatous disease in the vignette

rejected.label: Mucormycosis
rejected.why: Fungal culture on Sabouraud dextrose agar was negative, contradicting Mucormycosis

rejected.label: Oral ulcerative lesions
rejected.why: Too broad and nonspecific, does not explain the specific findings of intracellular yeasts and fungal forms
